currentPreviews.authorObservation: Two full separated capacitor plate pairs remain on upper and lower branches. C_1 is above the upper pair, C_2 below the lower pair. Four charged-state labels preserve +|q_1|/-|q_1| and +|q_2|/-|q_2|. Both vertical rails, upper/lower branches and two outward leads are complete. Exactly two filled mid-rail junction dots are present. No wires connect across either capacitor gap, and no formula or extra node name appears.

At the narrowest actual width, both pairs and their open gaps are distinct. Positive/negative signs and q subscripts remain visible, as do C_1/C_2 and both junction dots. Complete common-node routing is readable with no clipping, black raster failure, overlapping labels or added answer content.

The alternate narrow width preserves the same two branches and two conductor networks. All six labels, two junction dots, both terminals and four separate plates remain present. q_1 and q_2 are not replaced by one common charge label.

sourceInventoryMaps.description: The left bus runs vertically between the upper and lower branch corners. A filled junction dot midway joins an outward left lead. The upper and lower left branch wires meet the respective positive plates. All are one conductor.

The right bus runs vertically between upper and lower branch corners. A filled junction dot midway joins an outward right lead. The upper and lower right branch wires meet the respective negative plates. This conductor is separate from the left bus.

Exactly two thick vertical separated plates on the top branch, the left positive and the right negative in the depicted charged state. C_1 is printed above the pair. +|q_1| appears above/left and -|q_1| above/right. Wires meet the middle of the respective plates. Uncalibrated clean layout replaces scan irregularities.

Exactly two thick vertical separated plates on the bottom branch, again left positive and right negative. +|q_2| is below/left, -|q_2| below/right, and C_2 below the pair. Separate q_1 and q_2 magnitudes are printed; the pixels do not assert they are equal. Uncalibrated clean layout replaces scan irregularities.
No battery, switch, current arrows, ground symbol, resistor, dielectric insert, units, numerical values, formula, caption or ellipsis is printed inside the PNG.

figureEvidence.interpretation: Positive and negative shared nodes are separate; q_1/q_2 remain distinct rather than equalized.
figureEvidence.modernRegularization: Square clean corners, aligned plate centers, uniform strokes and mobile-readable labels. Internal coordinates are uncalibrated layout, not given distances. Unicode subscripts preserve the mathematical labels; no added node names or circuit formulas.

currentPreviews.authorObservation: One straight chain contains exactly two plate pairs labelled C_1/C_2. Both pairs show +|q| on the left and -|q| on the right, without q subscripts. U_1/U_2/U_3 remain below their three distinct conductor regions. The middle wire joins first negative to second positive with no branch, external terminal or junction dot. No equal-voltage annotation, charge equation, third capacitor or answer formula is added.

The two pairs are distinct at the narrowest width. All four charge-sign/magnitude labels, C_1/C_2 and U_1/U_2/U_3 can be read without overlap. Both outer leads and the complete isolated intermediate wire remain visible. No added branch or apparent short crosses either gap.

The alternate narrow preview preserves all nine original labels, two capacitor groups and three conductor regions. Charge signs and plate gaps remain distinct. The middle conductor has no external connection, consistent with the initially neutral/no-leakage qualification in current prose, without introducing a new graphical claim.

sourceInventoryMaps.description: The first pair has two separated vertical thick plates: positive on the left, negative on the right. +|q| is above/left, -|q| above/right and C_1 is below the pair. Neither q has a subscript.
The second pair is to the right, also left positive and right negative; it has +|q| and -|q| above and C_2 below. Both groups remain distinct.

A horizontal left lead ends at the first positive plate, with U_1 below it. A horizontal right lead leaves the second negative plate, with U_3 below it. No open circles or filled node dots are drawn at their outer ends.

A single straight horizontal wire directly connects the first negative plate to the second positive plate. U_2 is printed below this middle wire. It has no branch, ground, battery or extra terminal. The connected negative and positive plates belong to the same isolated intermediate conductor group, not two separately grounded nodes. Initial neutrality and no leakage are contextual conditions, not new graphical labels.
No q subscripts, third capacitor, junction dots, external intermediate branch, voltage-equality mark, current arrow, ground, battery, equation, dimensions or caption is printed.

figureEvidence.interpretation: The intermediate component has no branch. Printed +/-|q| is contextual charged-state information conditional on initially neutral intermediate group and no leakage, as stated in the unchanged full modern lesson. No new charge equation or voltage equality is shown.
figureEvidence.modernRegularization: One clean horizontal chain with evenly drawn plate glyphs and labels enlarged to at least 16 px at all supplied actual media widths. Equal glyph size is schematic and does not claim equal capacitance or equal voltage. No new neutral-node label or charge-conservation equation is added.
